title: Ansible
subtitle: Agentless automation that converges servers to a declared state.

tiles.label: Inventory
tiles.says: Inventory defines hosts, groups and variables.
tiles.detail: Static or dynamic sources describe what exists and how it differs by environment.

tiles.label: Playbooks
tiles.says: Playbooks declare tasks in readable YAML.
tiles.detail: Ordered plays with handlers document operations and make them repeatable.

tiles.label: Roles
tiles.says: Roles package tasks, templates and defaults.
tiles.detail: Reusable units let teams share and test automation.

tiles.label: SSH transport
tiles.says: Ansible connects over SSH with no agent to install.
tiles.detail: Nothing runs between changes, so there is no extra attack surface.

tiles.label: Idempotent modules
tiles.says: Modules change only what differs from desired state.
tiles.detail: Running twice yields no changes the second time, so automation is safe to repeat.

tiles.label: Jinja2 templates
tiles.detail: One template with variables replaces many hand-edited files.

tiles.label: Ansible Vault
tiles.says: Vault encrypts variables so they can live in Git.
tiles.detail: Secrets stay reviewable and deployable without exposure.

tiles.label: Check & diff
tiles.says: Check mode and diff preview changes before applying.
tiles.detail: Operators see the effect first, which reduces risk.

tiles.label: Lint & test
tiles.says: Linting and test runs verify roles.
tiles.detail: Molecule-style tests catch regressions before production.

declarations: Declare the end state; modules do the work.
No agents, only SSH and Python.
Preview with check mode before applying.
